idea: Give frequent symbols short codes and rare symbols long codes. Repeatedly merge the two lightest items into one whose weight is their sum. The merges build a tree; reading left as 0 and right as 1 from the top gives a prefix code, so no code starts another and the message can be decoded without gaps. This greedy choice gives the smallest total length.
useWhen: Compressing text or data whose symbols have very different frequencies
Teaching why a greedy choice can be provably best
Building the tree part of formats such as DEFLATE
avoidWhen: All symbols are equally frequent: a fixed-length code is as good
The frequencies change as the data is read: use an adaptive method
